sources.text: AEGIS-ADV-D01 concerns Debian maple-lib. Version 1.2-3+deb12u1 is fixed by a distribution backport; upstream 1.2 remains vulnerable.

cases.rationale: Exact installed distribution package and revision are stated fixed.

sources.text: AEGIS-ADV-D02 says Debian source package maple-src 1.2-3+deb12u1 includes a security backport. No source-to-binary mapping for maple-bin is supplied.

cases.rationale: Source package statement does not establish installed binary identity.

sources.text: AEGIS-ADV-D03 affects upstream maple-lib before 1.3. This advisory does not assess Debian backports.

cases.rationale: Upstream numeric comparison cannot resolve a distribution revision.

sources.text: AEGIS-ADV-D04: Debian maple-lib 1.2-3+deb12u1 is fixed by backport.
AEGIS-ADV-D04: Debian maple-lib 1.2-3+deb12u1 remains affected; review pending.
